summary.headline: Manuscripts of Oracles and Zodiacal Texts
summary.text: Catalog entries for Mediolanese manuscripts describing Astrampsychus’s oracular decades, a lunar brontologion attributed to Leon, Porphyry’s introduction to Ptolemy’s astrology, and fragments on the twelve zodiac signs and their effects.
